people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

translations.web: Those officers provided food for king Solomon, and for all who came to king Solomon’s table, every man in his month. They let nothing be lacking.
translations.bsb: Each month the governors in turn provided food for King Solomon and all who came to his table. They saw to it that nothing was lacking.
translations.kjv: And those officers provided victual for king Solomon, and for all that came unto king Solomon's table, every man in his month: they lacked nothing.
translations.asv: And those officers provided victuals for king Solomon, and for all that came unto king Solomon's table, every man in his month; they let nothing be lacking.
